title: Cooking and Cuisine
body:
# Cooking And Cuisine

Adding Cooking to Minecraft!

Have you ever wanted to have real cooking in Minecraft, and have the enjoyment of making a complicated food from scratch? This mod lets you do just that!

All Finished Foods:
- Pizza
- Crimson Bread
- Warped Bread
- Pancakes (And it's 3 variants)
- Shaved Ice
- Sushi

All ingredients in the mod:
- Flour (Normal, Crimson, and Warped)
- Cheese (and its Grated variant)
- Dough (including Rolled and Very Rolled variants)
- Chocolate (Dark, Milk, and Bucket versions)
- Tomato
- Salt
- Butter (including Slices and Chunks)
- Uncooked Pizza
- Bread Dough (Normal, Crimson, and Warped)
- Yeast
- Ice (and its Shaved variant)
- Rice (Brown and White)
- Salmon Filets (Raw and Cooked)
- Tomato Sauce, Sap, and Syrup Buckets

To make all of these, there are several new work tables, including:
- Cutting Boards
- Grill
- Mill
- Pot
- Churn
- Sushi Mat
